# Windsor Spraying

> Berkshire's specialist architectural spray painters. Transforming UPVC windows, composite doors, kitchen cabinets, and conservatories for up to 80% less than replacement cost, backed by an ironclad 10-year anti-fade guarantee.

## Core Expertise & Services
- UPVC Window Spraying: Full exterior and interior window frame respraying in durable satin or matt finishes.
- Kitchen Cabinet Respraying: Factory-grade respraying of kitchen doors, drawer fronts, cornices, and islands.
- Composite & Front Door Spraying: High-adhesion weatherproof coatings in over 1,500 RAL and Farrow & Ball colours.
- Conservatory & Orangery Spraying: Complete frame makeovers eliminating tired white or faded brown UPVC.
- Garage Doors & Architectural Metal: Roller, sectional, and up-and-over garage door transformations.
- Commercial & Shopfront Spraying: Retail, office, and commercial unit exterior spray rejuvenation.

## Working Region
Based in Windsor (SL4) and serving the wider Berkshire & Surrey areas:

- Bracknell
